_original_lore: The Dasher Spider is one of the types of spiders
found in the Spider's Den. It launches itself
towards the player, damaging them in the process.
name: 冲刺蜘蛛 (怪物)

source: The Dasher Spider is one of the types of spiders
found in the Spider's Den. It launches itself
towards the player, damaging them in the process.
loreParagraphs.translation: 冲刺蜘蛛是蜘蛛巢穴中发现的蜘蛛种类之一.它会朝玩家冲去,并在过程中造成伤害.
